question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `queryInstructionTemplate` as a boolean memory configuration and Plugin SDK option backed by built-in Qwen3 and Mixedbread model matching?
rationale: The PR expands persisted configuration and public provider contracts; code review cannot decide whether this model-family policy belongs in a shared SDK seam, a provider-owned private implementation, or a more generic explicit template API.

options.title: Approve The Opt-In Shared Seam
options.body: Accept the default-false boolean and shared helper as the supported contract, then require the outstanding copy/comment fixes, conflict resolution, compatibility tests, and current-head live proof.

options.title: Use An Explicit Template Contract
options.body: Replace the model-family boolean with a generic user-supplied query template or provider hook so core does not permanently own a hidden model-id catalog.

options.title: Keep Formatting Provider-Owned
options.body: Remove the new core config and public SDK surface and implement any query transformation only inside the owning provider integration.

recommendation.title: Approve The Opt-In Shared Seam
recommendation.body: Accept the default-false boolean and shared helper as the supported contract, then require the outstanding copy/comment fixes, conflict resolution, compatibility tests, and current-head live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant feature history shows ownership of the memory embedding adapter and provider boundaries affected by this product/API choice.
